modules.module_title: Pre- transplantation procedures

pcs.pc_description: ensure compliance with legal requirements as per the Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act and its subsequent amendments
assess if the patient’s family requires social support
address the concerns raised by the patient, live donor and families
evaluate suitability of patient and potential live donor for transplant
facilitate complete medical workup including HLA typing/DNA profiling, cross matching and psychosocial evaluation
collate findings and recommendations to be presented at multi-disciplinary transplant team meeting
facilitate care of live donor and patient pre- operatively
guide the live donor and patient about clinical protocols
explain the families about any unforeseen circumstances where the transplantation might not be possible
ensure consent or authorisation for donation is in accordance with national/ state regulations
advise the patient and family members about short and long-term complications after the transplantation
apprise the patient and family of the financial aspects of transplantation such as approximate cost of immunosuppression
guide the recipient about complications during transplantation such as chances of infection, potential of rejection, post-transplant and graft survival
advise the patient regarding the lifestyle modifications required, maintaining compliance to medication
facilitate preoperative procedures necessary for transplantation such as dialysis, final crossmatch
update concerned staff of appropriate departments regarding the transplant
assist the medical team in donor selection according to agreed principles and/or national regulations for organ or tissue donation and subsequent procedures
obtain the donor’s medical and behavioral history from appropriate relatives or other individuals
assist in examining donor-recipient pairing

modules.module_title: Care of living organ or tissue

maintain record of documents related to consent and authorization according to state and national regulations
provide care when donors are sub-optimal
ensure that the storage of living organ/ tissue for donation and transplantation is as per the national/state guidelines
ensure that the transport for transplantation of living organ/ tissue for donation is as per the national/state guidelines

modules.module_title: Post-transplantation procedures and follow up with live donor

pcs.pc_description: organize routine patient visits within structured appointment schedules
shuffle or reschedule appointments to deal with priority cases, emergencies and unusual time- consuming investigations
advise the live donor and family about immediate post-surgical care such as wound care, activity limitations, pain management

report any surgical, medical, and psychosocial complaints of transplant recipient and live donor to the attending physician/clinician/ surgeon
report the required data (transplant and post-transplant) to state regulatory body
maintain registry of transplant outcomes according to one’s own scope of work
